topic: What if the internet went down worldwide for one day? Payments, messages, maps and many businesses would stop.

episode.title: What If the Internet Went Down Worldwide for One Day?

shots.narration: What if the internet went down worldwide for one day?
shots.scene: Colourful 3D science lab, vertical frame, glowing Earth hologram without labels.
shots.action: nova presents a holographic Earth whose connecting light trails fade.
shots.mood: Bright turquoise lighting, curious expressions, dramatic violet globe.

shots.narration: Devices could stay powered, but online connections would fail.
shots.scene: Colourful lab beside a hologram of glowing phones and computers, no text.
shots.action: nova enlarges a hologram of powered devices separated by broken light trails.
shots.mood: Luminous screens, puzzled robot eyes, gentle scientific curiosity.

shots.scene: Lab hologram showing two phones with blank screens and an unmarked envelope between them.
shots.action: nova slides a holographic envelope into a gap between the phones.
shots.mood: Warm pink light, suspended envelope, surprised blue robot eyes.

shots.narration: Many card payments would fail, though some systems work offline.
shots.scene: Lab counter with a holographic payment terminal and blank bank card, no symbols or lettering.
shots.action: nova taps the blank card against a terminal that flashes amber.
shots.mood: Clean colourful surfaces, amber glow, thoughtful expressions.

shots.narration: Maps needing fresh downloads could leave blank spaces.
shots.scene: Lab with a floating street-map hologram made of unlabelled roads and blank tiles.
shots.action: nova expands a map whose outer tiles remain empty.
shots.mood: Blue roads fading into pale empty squares, curious concentration.

shots.narration: [sighs] Many businesses would pause tasks that depend on online services.
shots.scene: Lab hologram of a miniature warehouse with packages and an idle conveyor, no labels.
shots.action: nova freezes a holographic package beneath a disconnected computer.
shots.mood: Quiet conveyor, soft amber lighting, calm problem-solving atmosphere.

shots.narration: But cash could keep some purchases moving.
shots.scene: Colourful lab counter beside the payment hologram, with plain unmarked coins and an apple.
shots.action: nova places plain coins beside the apple.
shots.mood: Sunny gold lighting, cheerful smile, reassuring everyday objects.

shots.narration: Downloaded maps could still show your surroundings.
shots.scene: Lab with a holographic phone displaying a complete unlabelled street grid and glowing position dot.
shots.action: nova traces an intact road across the offline map.
shots.mood: Clear green route, bright blue glow, delighted robot eyes.

shots.narration: [surprised] GPS works offline—but what if satellites disappeared?
shots.scene: Lab beneath a tall Earth hologram with orbiting satellites and a phone below, no text.
shots.action: nova reveals glowing signal paths directly connecting satellites to the phone.
shots.mood: Sparkling orbital arcs, wide-eyed wonder, bright cosmic colours.

episode.endHook: GPS works offline—but what if satellites disappeared?
episode.description: Dr. Nova shows Byte how a worldwide internet outage could disrupt messages, payments, maps and businesses. But cash, downloaded maps and GPS reveal why offline doesn't mean everything stops.
